text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
D-Do I look that way? ...Perhaps it's because
I thoroughly enjoyed the racetrack during my time off.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I tried the popular mocha soft serve...
That bittersweet yet melt-in-your-mouth sweetness.
It was such a blissful moment.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Besides, the famous Trainer's talk show
was so educational... I feel inspiration flowing
for my next school newspaper column.
choice_data_list: Sounds great! I bet that was a lot of fun.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Oh, right.
It might be nice to visit a racetrack a bit further away next time.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "Since we're traveling far, I need to make sure my camera is well-maintained. And of course, I can't forget my race predictions... Hehe."
